name: Saleem Jaffer
bio: Saleem is a Senior Analyst Developer with a Computer Science degree and nearly a decade of experience building high-performance systems in the financial services and fintech space. His worked across the full stack — from low-latency trading infrastructure and market models to data pipelines and decision-making tools — with a strong focus on crypto and high-frequency trading.

As a co-founder of Alpha Crest, Saleem built the original systems that laid the foundation for the company’s growth. The vision behind Alpha Crest closely aligns with his personal mission: to create value in every space of life — whether it’s through technology, mentorship, or market innovation. Saleem has also co-founded startups in the job search and education sectors, bringing a blend of technical precision, product sense, and entrepreneurial drive.

Based in South Africa, he’s known for his calm approach to complex problems and his ability to turn ideas into scalable systems. Outside of work, you’ll find him running, geeking out over biohacking tools, or building GPT-powered automations — always chasing the next edge in performance, both human and machine.
